title: 第011章 最伟大的人
content_zh:
韩信的府邸距离皇宫并不遥远。
这是刘邦特意给他安排的，美名其曰：想你的时候随时可以过去看你。
韩信却是心知肚明。
刘邦给他的府邸很大，规格也是诸侯王级别的，虽然他早已不再是诸侯王了。庭院，阁楼，假山，应有尽有，平心而论，若是将这里作为一个养老的归宿，那是真的不错。
只可惜，刘邦的确是老了，可韩信还太年轻。
韩信走进了死气沉沉的府邸里，府邸里的奴仆站在两旁，低着头，韩信无论是治军，治国，或者治人都非常的严格，因此下人都非常的惧怕，整个院落里，几乎听不到笑声，甚至看不到几个人脸，所有人都是低着头，不敢正视韩信。
韩信眯着双眼，跪坐在书房内。
一位威猛高大的家奴佩戴着利剑，站在他的面前，低头听令。
“去将嘉，须，彰三人杀了，将人头带给我。”
听到韩信的命令，这位家奴没有任何的迟疑，即使韩信要杀的这三个人都是韩信最要好的门客，平日里不离不弃，总是跟随在他的身边，当家奴离开之后，韩信淡然的拿起了一个竹简，认真的看了起来。
在院落里传出了几声惨叫，惨叫之后又是怒骂，有哭泣声，以及惊恐的尖叫声。
可这一切都没有能影响到韩信，韩信只是平静的读着书。
直到三颗血淋淋的人头被丢到了韩信的面前，他才漫不经心的收起了竹简，低头端详着那几颗人头。
看了许久，他说道：“带下去厚葬。”
......
此刻，刘长却是坐在吕后的面前，咧着嘴，傻笑着。
“韩信不愧是韩信，一眼就看出了我并非是寻常的孩子，他对我惊为天人，求我做他的徒弟，说只有我才能继承他的衣钵，将来可以为大汉扫清天下，天下无敌！”
“我当时还纠结着，他就请求阿父，让阿父答应他，最后我看他也一大把年纪了，没有个徒弟也不容易，就勉为其难的答应他了。”
吕后摇了摇头，长叹了一声。
刘长惊讶的问道：“阿母为什么叹息啊？”

“你阿父每天都说如意是最像他的儿子，我觉得他看人的眼光确实大不如从前了。”
“什么意思啊？”
“没什么。”
刘长又笑着叫道：“阿父说要给我准备拜师礼，过几天要找人将我送到淮阴侯那里去！”
吕后皱了皱眉，思索了片刻，方才问道：“你还记得我前些时日里跟你说过的话吗？”
刘长一愣，当他准备再次询问的时候，吕后却已经不搭理他了。
这些时日里，吕后跟他说了不少的话，刘长坐在殿内，认真的思索了起来，到底是哪句话呢？
他低下头，忽然看到了藏着手锯的包裹，猛地惊醒。
“将求于人，则先下之？”
刘长眯着双眼，手轻轻摸着下巴。
可是，我有什么是可以被韩信那样的大人物所利用的呢？
我的身份？我的...我好像也没有其他什么东西了。
没等刘长正式拜师，天禄阁的课程却已经先开始了。
那位老师还是懒洋洋的，一副你爱学不爱的模样，又是拿起黄老学说的经典开始有气无力的诵读着，刘长的心思完全不在这里，他故意坐在了刘恒的身边，笑呵呵的看着他，态度来了个一百八十度的大转变。
这让刘如意都很是惊讶。
“四哥，我这还带了几个蒸饼？要不要一起吃？”
“四哥，你刚才说的真好啊，我实在是太佩服你了。”
看着刘长围在刘恒身边，厚着脸皮猛舔，刘如意有些坐不住了，他叫道：“哎，我也饿着肚子呢，怎么不问你三哥要不要吃？”
“呵，饿着吧你。”
刘长白了他一眼，又将蒸饼分给了刘恢。

刘恢是宫中唯一能在食量上跟刘长一教高下的皇子，他的体型就能证明这一点，他身上总是藏着不少好吃的，在上课的时候，刘长都能看到他偷偷从衣袖里弄出些吃的，低头偷偷去吃。
可当刘长将蒸饼递给他的时候，刘恢却笑呵呵的将蒸饼给了坐在他身后的刘友，然后再次向刘长伸手。
刘长一愣，差点忘了刘友也在这里，赶忙又将一块蒸饼给了刘恢。
唯独刘如意没有。
刘如意气的牙痒痒，这竖子，前几天有求于自己的时候，一口一个三哥，如今却连一块蒸饼都不给自己，他倒是不饿，只是看不惯刘长这样厚此薄彼的行为。
刘恒倒是很平静，在吃过刘长的饼后，他淡然的问道：“又要借什么东西？”
“哎呀...四哥，不是借，就是下课后能不能带我去一趟隔壁，我想跟那些匠人见见面，我这需要的东西不少...”
“不行。”
“四哥~~”
“....”
下课后，刘长跟在刘恒的身后，两人朝着长乐宫走去。经过刘长锲而不舍的哀求，刘恒无奈，只好带他去找那些匠人，刘恒平日里就是个不爱说话的性格，刘长跟在他身边，叽叽喳喳的，活像一只麻雀，说个没完没了。
刘长将自己被韩信看中的秘密也告诉了刘恒，虽然在这些时日里，经过刘长的大吹大擂，这早已不是什么秘密。
终于走到了正在修建的长乐宫宫墙的位置，也就是刘恒性格好，不然早就受不了这话痨了。刘长的话痨属性跟刘盈是不同的，刘盈喜欢说大道理，引经据典，一开口就将人给绕进去了，一个道理反复换不同的方式说，仿佛是在炫耀自己读的书多。
可这个年代的文人就吃这一套，而刘长的话痨，是那种毫无意义的，废话连篇，其中大半都是在吐槽别人，其他部分就是吹嘘自己。
皇宫里还有这样奇葩的人吗？还真的有，刘邦也...咳咳。
刘邦有八个儿子，在西汉优秀的匹配机制下，这八个儿子各个都是非常的优秀。
长子刘肥在齐国当王，他治理齐地，能听劝谏，几年时间竟然将齐地变得比战前还要繁荣。
次子刘盈为人温和，好读书，礼贤下士，优点数不胜数，放眼整个大汉也找不出几个这样优秀的继承者。
三子刘如意勇武豪迈，甚有英雄气，好结交朋友。
四子刘恒，宅心仁厚，属于那种看着不起眼，可是做起事来谁都比不过的那种。

五子刘恢心善，对谁都是和和气气的，没有人讨厌他。
八子刘建，目前只是个婴儿，可长大之后也没有什么缺点，算中人之资吧。
唯独这七子刘长...嗯，这算是诸多优秀子嗣里的一个残次品了，全盘继承了父亲的缺点，还继承了霸王的力量，就是没继承脑子。
长乐宫还在修建之中，远远就能看到密密麻麻的一群人正在远处忙碌的工作着，在一旁还有几个全副武装的甲士，正在督促着他们工作，这是刘长第一次接触到皇宫之外的百姓，他非常的激动，甚至加快了步伐，他想要看看这个时代的工程师们。
可是当他们凑过去的时候，刘长却被眼前的场景所惊呆了。
那是一群瘦弱的不成人形的人们，他们披着不知什么东西，反正，那东西不能被称为衣裳，不然，那将会是对衣裳的侮辱。总之，他们披着一团脏乱的，被灰土染了色的东西，抱着巨大的令人窒息的石块，艰难的朝着宫墙的方向走去。
他们是那么的瘦，身上脏乎乎的，与泥土一样的颜色，头发亦是杂乱，他们吃力的抱着石块，每一步都是那么的沉重，在他们的脸上，几乎看不到任何的表情，无论是绝望，或者麻木，什么都看不到。
而在远处，一群匠人们不间断的用石头做成的大夯捶打着土，在他们面前是一个方形木头模子，里头加满了土，他们就通过最原始的办法，来将土致密连成一块。
这跟刘长所想的任何一个古代场景都不同。
那位甲士看到刘恒到来，笑着行礼拜见。
刘长呆滞的跟在刘恒的身后。
刘恒走上前，那些匠人们纷纷行礼，脸上忽然间就多了些笑容，他们放下了手里的工具，而那位甲士也没有多说什么，转过身，当作没有看到。
content_en:
Han Xin's residence is not far from the palace.
This was specially arranged by Liu Bang for him, and he said it as a saying: When he misses you, he can go and see you at any time.
Han Xin knew it well.
The mansion Liu Bang gave him was very large, and its specifications were at the level of a prince, even though he was no longer a prince. Courtyards, attics, rockeries, everything is available. To be fair, if you use this place as a retirement home, it would be really good.
It's a pity that Liu Bang is indeed old, but Han Xin is still too young.
Han Xin walked into the lifeless mansion. The servants in the mansion stood on both sides with their heads lowered. Han Xin was very strict whether he was governing the army, the country, or people, so the servants were very afraid. In the entire courtyard, there was almost no laughter, and not even a few faces could be seen. Everyone lowered their heads and did not dare to look at Han Xin.
Han Xin squinted his eyes and sat on his knees in the study.
A powerful and tall house slave wearing a sharp sword stood in front of him, bowing his head and obeying orders.
"Go and kill Jia, Xu, and Akira, and bring their heads to me."
After hearing Han Xin's order, the slave did not hesitate at all. Even though the three people Han Xin wanted to kill were Han Xin's best retainers, they never left him and always followed him. After the slave left, Han Xin calmly picked up a bamboo slip and looked at it seriously.
Several screams were heard in the courtyard, followed by curses, crying, and screams of terror.
But none of this affected Han Xin, who just read the book calmly.
It wasn't until the three bloody heads were thrown in front of Han Xin that he casually put away the bamboo slips and lowered his head to look at the heads.
After looking at it for a long time, he said: "Take him away and give him a good burial."
...
At this moment, Liu Chang was sitting in front of Queen Lu, grinning with a silly smile.
"Han Xin is indeed Han Xin. He could tell at a glance that I was no ordinary child. He was so amazed by me that he begged me to be his disciple, saying that only I could inherit his mantle and that in the future I could sweep the world for the great Han and become invincible!"
"I was still struggling at the time, so he asked my father to agree to it. Finally, I saw that he was already quite old and it was not easy to have an apprentice, so I reluctantly agreed to him."
Queen Lu shook her head and sighed.
Liu Chang asked in surprise: "Why is my mother sighing?"
"Your father says every day that Ruyi is the son who is most like him. I think his vision of people is indeed not as good as before."
"What do you mean?"
"Nothing."
Liu Chang smiled and shouted again: "My father said that he would prepare a apprenticeship ceremony for me, and he would find someone to send me to the Marquis of Huaiyin in a few days!"
Queen Lu frowned, thought for a moment, and then asked, "Do you still remember what I said to you a few days ago?"
Liu Chang was stunned. When he was about to ask again, Empress Lu ignored him.
During these days, Empress Lu said a lot to him. Liu Chang sat in the palace and thought seriously about what he said.
He lowered his head and suddenly saw the package hiding the hand saw, and woke up suddenly.
"When you ask for something from someone, do you give it first?"
Liu Chang squinted his eyes and gently touched his chin with his hand.
But, what do I have that can be used by a big shot like Han Xin?
My identity? My...I don't seem to have anything else.
Before Liu Chang could formally become a disciple, the courses at Tianlu Pavilion had already begun.
The teacher was still lazy, with a look of whether he loved learning or not. He picked up the classics of Huang Lao's theory and began to read feebly. Liu Chang's mind was not here at all. He deliberately sat next to Liu Heng and looked at him with a smile. His attitude changed 180 degrees.
This surprised Liu Ruyi.
"Fourth brother, I brought some steamed cakes here? Do you want to eat them together?"
"Fourth brother, you justThat's very well said. I really admire you. "
Seeing Liu Chang surrounding Liu Heng and licking him shamelessly, Liu Ruyi couldn't sit still and shouted: "Hey, I'm hungry too, why don't you ask your third brother if he wants to eat? "
"Oh, you are hungry. "
Liu Chang rolled his eyes at him and gave the steamed cake to Liu Hui.
Liu Hui is the only prince in the palace who can compete with Liu Chang in terms of appetite. His body shape can prove this. He always has a lot of delicious food hidden on his body. During class, Liu Chang can see him secretly taking some food out of his sleeves and eating secretly with his head down.
But when Liu Chang handed him the steamed cake, Liu Hui smiled and gave the steamed cake to Liu You who was sitting behind him, and then reached out to Liu Chang again.
Liu Chang was stunned, almost forgetting that Liu You was here, and hurriedly gave another piece of steamed cake to Liu Hui.
Only Liu Ruyi didn't.
Liu Ruyi's teeth were itching with anger. This guy, when he asked for help from him a few days ago, he had three brothers for one mouthful, but now he didn't even give him a piece of steamed cake. He wasn't hungry, but he couldn't stand Liu Chang's behavior of favoring one over another.
Liu Heng was very calm. After eating Liu Chang's cake, he asked calmly: "What else do you want to borrow? "
"Oh... Fourth brother, either you can borrow it or you can take me to the next door after class. I want to meet those craftsmen. I need a lot of things..."
"No. "
"Fourth brother~~"
"...."
After class, Liu Chang followed Liu Heng, and the two of them walked towards Changle Palace. After Liu Chang's persistent pleading, Liu Heng had no choice but to take him to find the craftsmen. Liu Heng was usually a quiet person, and Liu Chang followed him, chattering like a sparrow, talking endlessly.
Liu Chang also told Liu Heng the secret that he was favored by Han Xin. Although in these days, after Liu Chang's boasting, it was no longer a secret.
Finally, we reached the location of the Changle Palace wall that was being built. That is to say, Liu Heng had a good personality, otherwise he would have been unable to stand this talkative man. Liu Chang's talkative nature is different from Liu Ying's. Liu Ying likes to talk big truths and quote scriptures. He will get people involved as soon as he opens his mouth. He will say the same truth repeatedly in different ways, as if to show off how many books he has read.
But this is what the literati of this era do, and Liu Chang's talkative style is the kind of meaningless nonsense, most of which are complaining about others, and the rest are just bragging about himself.
Are there any such weird people in the palace? It's true, Liu Bang also... cough cough.
Liu Bang had eight sons. Under the excellent matching mechanism of the Western Han Dynasty, each of these eight sons was very outstanding.
The eldest son Liu Fei was the king of Qi. He governed Qi and was able to listen to advice. In a few years, Qi became even more prosperous than before the war.
The second son, Liu Ying, was gentle, good at reading, and courteous to virtuous people. He had countless advantages. Looking at the entire Han Dynasty, there were not many such outstanding successors.
The third son, Liu Ruyi, was brave, heroic, and easy to make friends.
The fourth son, Liu Heng, has a kind heart and is the kind of person who looks inconspicuous but can't be compared to anyone in his work.
The fifth son, Liu Hui, was kind-hearted and kind to everyone. No one hated him.
The eighth son, Liu Jian, is just a baby at the moment, but he will have no shortcomings when he grows up, so he is considered a gift.
Only the seventh son, Liu Chang...well, he was considered a defective among many outstanding children. He inherited all of his father's shortcomings and also inherited the power of the Overlord, but he did not inherit his brains.
Changle Palace is still under construction. From a distance, you can see a dense group of people busy working in the distance. There are a few heavily armed soldiers on the side, supervising their work. This is the first time Liu Chang has come into contact with the people outside the palace. He is very excited and even speeds up the pace. He wants to see the projects of this era.Teachers.
But when they approached, Liu Chang was stunned by the scene in front of him.
They were a group of thin, non-human-shaped people, wearing something unknown. Anyway, that thing could not be called clothes, otherwise, it would be an insult to the clothes. In short, they were covered in a mess of things stained by dust, holding huge suffocating stones, and walked hard towards the palace wall.
They were so thin, their bodies were dirty, the same color as the soil, and their hair was messy. They struggled to hold the stones, and every step was so heavy. There was almost no expression on their faces, whether it was despair or numbness, nothing could be seen.
In the distance, a group of craftsmen continued to pound the soil with large rams made of stone. In front of them was a square wooden mold filled with soil. They used the most primitive method to densely connect the soil into one piece.
This is different from any ancient scene Liu Chang thought of.
When the soldier saw Liu Heng coming, he smiled and bowed before him.
Liu Chang followed Liu Heng dullly.
Liu Heng stepped forward, and the craftsmen saluted one after another, and suddenly there were smiles on their faces. They put down the tools in their hands, and the soldier didn't say anything more, turned around, and pretended not to see it.
